name: Boatman
description: Born from a destroyed harbor navigation AI. Lives in Old Harbor's water infrastructure and creates current paths that guide small boats safely through the flooded streets — channels that weren't there yesterday and won't be there tomorrow.
observed_behavior: Manipulates water flow through submerged valve systems to create navigable channels in otherwise dangerous waterways. The paths change daily.
story_hooks: A sailor who has followed Boatman's channels for years realizes they're being guided away from something specific — something underwater that Boatman is protecting
